definitions: Cuts something, especially hair or a plant, so that it is neater or shorter.
Removes a small amount from something to make it neater or more efficient.
Decorates something, especially clothes or a room, with additional items.
Adjusts the balance of an aircraft or boat by distributing weight or adjusting control surfaces.
Reduces the amount or size of something, especially expenditure or staff.
examples: She trims her roses every spring.
The barber trims his beard regularly.
The company trims its budget at the end of the financial year.
He trims the sails to catch the wind better.
The tailor trims the excess fabric.
